static.solution:
A. 2 + {2\over 2} + {2\over 3} + {2\over 4} + \cdots is not a geometric series.
B. 1 + 2 x + 4 x + 6 x + 8 x + \cdots is not a geometric series.
C. 2 + 2 x + 2 x^2 + 2 x^4 + 2 x^8 + \cdots is not a geometric series.
